## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.10

This release adds a new phase-independent diagnostic sensor for easier troubleshooting and live validation.

### New general Debug sensor

A new GrowAssistant Debug entity now combines diagnostics from across the crop-steering cycle, including:

- Current phase and light-cycle timing
- VWC readings and averaging
- P1 state, window, shot counters, and soak status
- P2 reference VWC, drop threshold, shot counters, soak status, and end-offset status
- Last-shot timestamp and source
- Drain and drain-tray safety status
- Human-readable block reason
- Detailed blocking and passed-condition diagnostics

### Compatibility

- The existing P1 Debug sensor remains available.
- The existing Block Reason sensor remains available.
- No irrigation logic or pump-control behavior was changed.
